description: This file implements a file-based storage provider for Orleans grains, including the main provider class 'OrleansFileStorage' and the internal data management class 'GrainStateFileDataManager'. It provides methods for reading, writing, and deleting grain state data stored as files on the filesystem.

classes.name: OrleansFileStorage
classes.description: A storage provider implementation for file-backed storage in Orleans, extending 'BaseJSONStorageProvider' and configured with a root directory.

classes.name: GrainStateFileDataManager
classes.description: Handles interactions with the file system for reading, writing, and deleting grain state files.

methods.name: OrleansFileStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the storage provider with a specified root directory.

methods.name: GrainStateFileDataManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the file system directory for storing grain state data.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the file associated with the specified grain state.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the grain state data from the corresponding file.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes grain state data to the corresponding file.

methods.name: GetStorageFilePath
methods.description: Generates the FileInfo object for the storage file based on collection name and key.
